<includeonly>{{#invoke:Infobox|main
|kind=dmz-mob
|sep=,
|title={{#if:{{{title|}}}|{{{title}}}|{{#invoke:Labels|name}}}}
|image={{#invoke:Labels|image|{{{image|}}}}}
|caption={{{caption|}}}
|sections=Summary, General, Combat, Rewards

|Summary=Quote
|Summary_nolabel=yes
|Quote_nolabel=yes
|Quote={{#if:{{{quote|}}}|''{{{quote}}}''}}

|General=Type, Dimension, Spawns, Behavior
|General_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|General}}
|Type_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Type}}
|Dimension_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Dimension}}
|Spawns_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Spawns}}
|Behavior_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Behavior}}

|Combat=Health, Damage, Ki damage, Abilities
|Combat_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Combat}}
|Health_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Health}}
|Health={{#if:{{{Health|}}}|{{formatnum:{{{Health}}}}}}}
|Damage_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Damage}}
|Ki damage_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Ki damage}}
|Abilities_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Abilities}}

|Rewards=Drops, TP reward
|Rewards_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Rewards}}
|Rewards_collapsible=yes
|Drops_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Drops}}
|TP reward_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|TP reward}}
|TP reward={{#if:{{{TP reward|}}}|{{formatnum:{{{TP reward}}}}}}}
}}[[Category:Bestiary{{#translation:}}]]</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
